lines.en: Amara, good to see you! I was going to call you yesterday, but I forgot the shop closes early on Sundays.
lines.pt: Amara, que bom ver você! Eu ia ligar para você ontem, mas esqueci que a loja fecha cedo aos domingos.

lines.en: No worries. I was going to come in on Monday, but my screen cracked on the bus, and I couldn't wait any longer.
lines.pt: Sem problema. Eu ia passar aqui na segunda, mas minha tela rachou no ônibus, e não deu para esperar mais.

lines.en: Ouch, that's painful. Your new phone should've been in stock last week, but the delivery got delayed by a storm.
lines.pt: Poxa, que dor. Seu celular novo devia estar no estoque na semana passada, mas a entrega atrasou por causa de uma tempestade.

lines.en: A storm? That's unlucky. I wanted to ask about the warranty first, though. Does it cover cracked screens?
lines.pt: Uma tempestade? Que azar. Mas eu queria perguntar antes sobre a garantia. Ela cobre telas rachadas?

lines.en: Good question. Drops aren't covered, I'm afraid, and I was going to suggest a protective case anyway. They're half price this week.
lines.pt: Boa pergunta. Quedas não são cobertas, infelizmente, e eu ia sugerir uma capa protetora de qualquer jeito. Estão pela metade do preço esta semana.

lines.en: Smart. My sister offered me her old phone, but she lost it on a train last week, so I'm stuck with this cracked one.
lines.pt: Esperto. Minha irmã me ofereceu o celular velho dela, mas o perdeu num trem semana passada, então estou presa a este aqui rachado.

lines.en: That's rough. A customer almost bought the last model this morning, but he changed his mind about the color at the last second.
lines.pt: Que chato. Um cliente quase comprou o último modelo hoje cedo, mas mudou de ideia sobre a cor na última hora.

lines.en: So you still have one? I'd love the blue one, if possible. The black looks a little boring to me.
lines.pt: Então ainda tem um? Eu adoraria o azul, se possível. O preto me parece meio sem graça.

lines.en: We've got both. I'll put the blue one aside right now, but I need your number again, since the old system lost half our contacts in the transfer.
lines.pt: Temos os dois. Vou separar o azul agora mesmo, mas preciso do seu número de novo, porque o sistema antigo perdeu metade dos contatos na transferência.

lines.en: Sure, it's 555-0143. Honestly, I should've given it to you sooner. Can I pick it up after lunch?
lines.pt: Claro, é 555-0143. Sinceramente, eu devia ter dado antes. Posso buscar depois do almoço?

lines.en: After lunch is perfect. I'll transfer your contacts while you wait, and I'll text you the second anything changes.
lines.pt: Depois do almoço está perfeito. Vou transferir seus contatos enquanto você espera, e mando mensagem assim que algo mudar.

pages.title: I was going to call you, but I forgot · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy afternoon in Seattle. Rui walks into a phone shop. His screen has a long crack across it. New phones fill the shelves. Dirk is behind the counter. Both of them have forgotten something.

“Rui, good to see you! I was going to call you yesterday, but I forgot that the shop closed early.” says Dirk. “No problem. I was going to come on Monday, but my screen cracked, so I could not wait any longer.” says Rui. “We were going to have your new phone in stock last week, but the delivery was delayed by a storm.” says Dirk.
